auth.description: Your Mixmax API token (X-API-Token). Find it at Settings > API in Mixmax.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Create a new contact in Mixmax. [See the documentation](https://developer.mixmax.com/reference/contacts-1)

enrich.description: Merge third-party data for this contact if enrichment sources are connected

aiMetadata.description: Adds a new contact to the Mixmax contact list, keyed by email (the only required field; name is optional). Optionally enriches the contact with third-party data when enrichment sources are connected. Not idempotent — each call creates/registers the contact again.

find_contact.name: find_contact
find_contact.description: Search for a contact in Mixmax. [See the documentation](https://developer.mixmax.com/reference/contactsquery)

query.description: Email address or name to search for

includeSalesforceContacts.description: Include Salesforce contacts in search results

aiMetadata.description: Searches Mixmax contacts by a query string (email address or name), which is required. Use to look up an existing contact before acting on it; optionally include Salesforce contacts in the results. Read-only and idempotent.

search.description: Filter contacts by name or email

aiMetadata.description: Lists Mixmax contacts, optionally filtering by a name/email search term and sorting by name, email, last used, or used count. With no search term it returns all contacts; provide a term to narrow to matches. Use to enumerate or browse contacts rather than to look up a single one. Read-only and idempotent.

create_code_snippet.name: create_code_snippet
create_code_snippet.description: Create a new code snippet in Mixmax. [See the documentation](https://developer.mixmax.com/reference/codesnippets-1)

html.description: The HTML content of the code snippet (as it appears in the editor)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a reusable code snippet in Mixmax from required HTML content, with optional title, syntax-highlighting language, background color, and editor theme. Use to save a code block for later insertion into emails. Not idempotent — each call creates a new snippet.

list_code_snippets.name: list_code_snippets
list_code_snippets.description: List all code snippets in Mixmax. [See the documentation](https://developer.mixmax.com/reference/codesnippets)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves all code snippets in the Mixmax account. Takes no input. Use to enumerate available snippets or to find a snippet id before reusing it. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your Mixmax API token (X-API-Token). Find it at Settings > API in Mixmax.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Your Mixmax API token (X-API-Token). Find it at Settings > API in Mixmax.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
